observations: Photo 0: Automatic transmission bell housing with torque converter inside, on bare earth.
Photo 1: External side of a metal transmission casing with fluid cooler lines attached.
Photo 2: Open transmission interior showing clutch packs, with torque converter placed beside it.
All photos carry the watermark "FIDEL AUTOS GLOBAL POSTED ON JIJI".
No brand badge, model plate, or part number is legible in any photo.

claims.evidence: Photos show casing and torque converter but cannot confirm all internal parts are present.
No M272 marking visible in any photo; M272 is an engine code, not a gearbox code.
Depends on negotiation with buyer, not shown in photos.

risks.risk: Internal clutches or bands may be worn or burnt
risks.proof: Video of internal components rotating or close-up of clutch pack condition

risks.risk: Transmission casing may have cracks or impact damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all external casing seams and mounting points

risks.risk: Mechatronic unit or valve body may be missing
risks.proof: Photo of the top side showing the mechatronic and electrical connector

risks.risk: Torque converter may be damaged or not included
risks.proof: Photo of torque converter installed or separate with no internal debris visible

risks.risk: Gearbox may not fit an M272 engine
risks.proof: Photo of part number plate matching M272 application

proof_requests: Photo of any part number or identification plate on the gearbox
Video showing the internal gears rotating freely
Photo of the mechatronic or valve body side of the transmission
Close-up photos of the casing for cracks or repairs
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an automatic gearbox with torque converter, so it can be priced at worst case as non-working and incomplete; no missing shot prevents a worst-case price.
